name: Advocate Health Care hospital volunteers (ages 16 and up)
city: Chicago area, IL (including Advocate Sherman Hospital in Elgin)
what_you_do: Volunteer at an Advocate hospital near you, in departments matched to your interests. Most spots are a set shift of 2 to 4 hours once a week. There are no shadowing roles.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and up. Some Advocate hospitals take 14 and 15 year olds; ask the hospital you want.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The health screening and any missing shots are free.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply to the hospital you want any time.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer application for the hospital you want. If there is a match you get an interview. Then do online training and a free health screening with a TB blood test and proof of MMR and flu shots.
notes: Not everyone is accepted. The background check is only for volunteers 18 and older. The Advocate Sherman page in Elgin links to this system-wide volunteer page.
